question: Two trains are traveling in opposite directions at the same speed. If each train is 968 m long and they pass each other in 22 seconds, what is the speed of each train?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Opposite direction ⇒ relative speed = sum of speeds

Total distance = 968 + 968 = 1936 m

Relative speed = 1936 ÷ 22 = 88 m/s

Each train speed = 88 ÷ 2 = 44 m/s

**∴ Answer = 44 m/s**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length of each train = 968 m

Time to cross each other = 22 sec

Trains move in opposite directions

**Formula used:**

Relative speed = Total distance ÷ Time

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total distance covered = 968 + 968 = 1936 m

⇒ Relative speed = 1936 ÷ 22 = 88 m/s

⇒ Let speed of each train = v

⇒ Opposite direction ⇒ relative speed = v + v = 2v

⇒ 2v = 88

⇒ v = 44 m/s

**∴ The correct answer is 44 m/s **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed

Opposite direction ⇒ speeds add, Same direction ⇒ speeds subtract

Train Crossing Concept

Total distance = sum of lengths when two trains cross each other

Speed Conversion

m/s to km/hr ⇒ multiply by 18 ÷ 5

Basic Formula

Speed = Distance ÷ Time
